title: RTEC AAP binder cover, tabs and section-divider history

components.finding: The two cover binaries are SHA-distinct but extracted text is effectively the same plan-year list spanning July 2018-June 2023; punctuation/dash representation differs.
components.role: presentation/period cover, not substantive policy authority

components.finding: The FY2022 and generic binder index are byte-identical and should resolve to one canonical template.
The FY2022 divider set is dated June 30, 2022; the Forms/Binder variant is updated to June 30, 2023 and adds a Commonwealth of Kentucky Certifications divider in the extracted ordering.

deduplication_rules: Index tabs are reusable scaffolding and should have one canonical source when hashes are identical.
Covers/dividers with different reporting dates are versions, not duplicates, even when layout is nearly identical.
Binder presentation files should link to substantive analysis sources rather than duplicate their content.
A stale cover year must never be used to infer the effective period of the underlying analyses; use the analysis source dates.
automation_candidate: Generate AAP cover, index tabs and dividers from a plan manifest/reporting date so stale years and missing sections cannot survive copy-forward.
